journey.title: Roots · Philippines
journey.body: Born and raised in the Philippines — where curiosity about how games worked turned into curiosity about how everything worked.

journey.title: The Move · California
journey.body: Immigrated to the Bay Area — new country, new everything. Started over at De Anza College and made it count: 3.74 GPA, club president, two game jams directed.

journey.title: Now · CS @ UCI
journey.body: Studying CS at UC Irvine while shipping real systems — an internship at Unimode AI and an AI/ML externship with Pfizer.

greetings.🐉: *uncurls a smoky tail* A hatchling of ancient fire, at your service. Ask away.
greetings.🦊: *ears perk up* Oh! A visitor. I was just about to nap. What do you want to know?
greetings.🐺: *circles once, sits* I run with Anjoelo's pack. Ask your questions, traveler.
greetings.🦉: *blinks slowly* Ah, a seeker of knowledge. I have been awake this whole time, obviously.
greetings.🐢: *pokes head out of shell* ...give me a second... okay, I'm ready. Go slow, I like slow.
greetings.🐦: *chirps twice, hops closer* Tweet tweet! That means hello. Ask me something!
greetings.🐲: *small wings flutter* I may be little, but I know all of Anjoelo's secrets. Try me.
greetings.🦇: *hangs upside down, opens one eye* Ask quick, before I doze off again.
greetings.🐍: *coils curiously* Ssssummoned, are we? Sssspeak your quessstion.
greetings.🦁: *shakes a tiny mane* Roar! (that means hi.) State your business, adventurer.
greetings.🐸: *ribbit* Hopped all the way here for you. What's the quest, friend?
greetings.🦎: *tilts head, changes color slightly* Curious little thing, aren't I? Ask away.
greetings.🐧: *waddles into view* Brrr, chilly out here. Warm me up with a good question.
greetings.🦅: *swoops down, lands*  I've seen this whole resume from above. Ask and I'll tell you.
greetings.🐨: *yawns, clings to a branch* Mm? Oh, right, you're here. What did you want to ask?
greetings.🐼: *rolls over, munching* Five more minutes... okay fine, I'm up. Go ahead.
greetings.🍕: *a slice waddles over, somehow* I am not an animal. I am pizza. Ask me anything anyway.
greetings.🍔: *wobbles proudly on its bun* You have summoned... a burger. This was not in the plan, but here we are.
greetings.🍩: *rolls in circles happily* Sprinkles and secrets, that's what I'm made of. Ask away!
greetings.🍗: *a drumstick with eyes blinks at you* This is unusual, even for me. Go on, ask your question.

familiar.fallbackGreeting: *looks up at you* Ask me anything.

main.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Semantic search API over 1.3M+ indexed records — cut p95 latency from 700ms to 200ms.
Automated onboarding pipeline — demo setup from ~3 days to under 4 hours.
Multi-agent adapter normalizing client schemas — hours of manual mapping to seconds.

main.title: AI/ML Extern
bullets: Document pipeline extracting structured data from scanned pharma PDFs with Tesseract, PaddleOCR, and frontier LLMs.
Multi-agent RAG system with LlamaIndex for semantic search over unstructured regulatory documents.
Regression harness — 20+ factual-retrieval and hallucination queries across 500+ documents.

side.title: Assistant Restaurant Manager — Country Gourmet American Bistro
bullets: Managed and trained a front service team of 9, resolving customer conflicts to raise overall service quality.
Oversaw technical operations to streamline daily processes, keeping the team efficient without burning out.

side.title: STEM Teaching Assistant
bullets: Tutored 30+ students per term in calculus, linear algebra, and physics.

side.title: STEM Teacher

side.title: STEM Tutor
bullets: Embedded in-class tutor, working alongside instructors on real-time problem-solving; mentored underrepresented students in STEM.

items.label: Lute
items.desc: Guitar started as a way to unwind between problem sets and turned into writing and recording my own stuff — mostly lo-fi, mostly late at night.

items.label: Boxing Gloves
items.desc: Muay Thai is where I go to think about nothing. A few sessions a week keeps me sharp and honest about how much I can actually push through.

items.label: TCG Cards
items.desc: Collecting and deck-building scratches the same itch as engineering — optimizing under constraints, just with more foil cards involved.

items.label: Controller
items.desc: Where I first got curious about how software works. Still my go-to for game nights and co-op runs with friends.

items.label: Compass
items.desc: New cities force me to problem-solve outside my usual toolkit — reading transit maps, ordering in another language, getting comfortably lost. Every trip resets how I see a problem.

projects.title: AI/ML Extern — Pfizer
bullets: Document pipeline extracting structured data from scanned pharma PDFs with Tesseract, PaddleOCR, and frontier LLMs.
Multi-agent RAG system with LlamaIndex for semantic search over unstructured regulatory documents.

projects.title: PlanPal
bullets: AI-assisted scheduler converting natural-language requests into structured, confidence-scored tasks through a multi-agent Gemini pipeline (Parser → Temporal → Normalization → Validation).
RAG chatbot grounded in live task context, answering scheduling questions via Gemini 2.0 Flash with a FastAPI backend and Streamlit UI.
Built a 3-tier evaluation harness (baseline vs. few-shot, adversarial robustness, context sensitivity) — few-shot prompting scored 96.7% vs. 88.3% baseline across 12 test cases.

projects.title: Study Guild
bullets: Gamified multi-agent AI study tool generating in-scope study guides and quizzes from class modules and notes.
Database design that lets collected modules improve AI-generated quiz specialization per user.

projects.title: Scantry
bullets: Building a grocery inventory tracking system using Raspberry Pi and open-source Grocy.

questLog.mainIntro: I find the edge cases more interesting than the happy path — reliable evaluation, honest failure modes, real constraints around latency and cost. That's the terrain I enjoy.
questLog.sideIntro: Not everything is in a terminal. These jobs taught me the stuff that doesn't show up in a commit log.
